headline: Home Rule Petition HRP for a short term rental excise charge to fund homelessness prevention and shelter services.
summary: The meeting will discuss Home Rule Petition HRP # 492 on a Short Term Rental (STR) excise charge. The petition authorizes creation of a new City Fund for homelessness prevention and shelter services.
items: # 492 Home Rule Petition HRP on a Short Term Rental (STR) excise charge to fund homelessness prevention and shelter services
Authorizes creation of a new City Fund for these purposes
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor

City of Salem, Massachusetts

October 22, 2026 
 
 
MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The City Council Committee on Administration and Finance co-posted with the 
Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Thursday December 3, 2026, at 6:00 PM 
for the purpose of discussing Home Rule Petition HRP Short Term Rental (STR) Excise 
Charge to fund Homelessness Prevention, and Shelter Services.  Authorizes the creation a 
new City Fund for these purposes.   
 
This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 
2nd Floor.
